promotions.title: Beloved Bihar at Kanak
promotions.detail: Some of Bihar’s most compelling flavours rarely make the familiar list.
promotions.story: Some of Bihar’s most compelling flavours rarely make the familiar list. For five days, Guest Chef Shubhra Singh brings them to Kanak through Beloved Bihar — an heirloom feast inspired by the recipes and culinary traditions of Balua Deorhi. We look forward to hosting you at Kanak from 21 to 25 September 2026 for lunch & dinner.
promotions.full: Some of Bihar’s most compelling flavours rarely make the familiar list. For five days, Guest Chef Shubhra Singh brings them to Kanak through Beloved Bihar — an heirloom feast inspired by the recipes and culinary traditions of Balua Deorhi. Joined by Chef Ananya Khare, she presents a menu that goes beyond the staples to explore the regional richness of Bihari cuisine. 21–25 September 2026 Lunch | 12:30–3 PM | Dinner | 7–11 PM 📍 Kanak in Trident, Hyderabad Reserve your table: +91 93910 04315 RestaurantReservations.TTHY@tridenthotels.comView all comments

promotions.title: Beloved Bihar at Kanak
promotions.detail: A feast that begins in Balua Deorhi and finds its way to Kanak.
promotions.story: A feast that begins in Balua Deorhi and finds its way to Kanak. This September, Beloved Bihar brings the heirloom flavours of Guest Chef Shubhra’s ancestral village to Kanak - a feast rooted in memory, tradition and the recipes that make a place feel like home. We look forward to hosting you at Kanak from 21 to 25 September 2026 for lunch & dinner.

promotions.title: Cocktails at Ninety Six
promotions.detail: Think Negroni, but with a softer, more indulgent side.
promotions.story: Think Negroni, but with a softer, more indulgent side. Italian Affair is bittersweet, silky and subtly nutty, with just enough savoury depth to make it intriguing. We look forward to hosting you at Ninety Six.
promotions.full: Think Negroni, but with a softer, more indulgent side. Italian Affair is bittersweet, silky and subtly nutty, with just enough savoury depth to make it intriguing. On the table, it pairs perfectly with Burrata and Mushroom Brioche - creamy, earthy and made to complement every sip. Discover the Quattro cocktails at ninety six in Trident, Hyderabad. Reserve your table at +91 93910 04315 or RestaurantReservations.TTHY@tridenthotels.com
